verdict.rationale: Obsidian is a note-taking app rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack never mentions an official MCP server. The headless Sync client "useful for... agents", the plugin API, Obsidian URI and community LLM plugins are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not a first-party MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
